Table_title: Spatial validation of frozen MS3 programs across GSE281759 sections

Source_columns.E:\\TCGA\\LIHC_scRNA_Step32_Spatial_Vali: JSON keys / saved indexed locator recorded in DATA _row

Frozen_status: Frozen/final saved sources; Step1/2 values use supplied static audit index; unresolved entries explicitly NA
Transformation: Select fixed rows/columns, source-preserving joins, concatenate labeled blocks, translate text only; source metadata row counts are QA only; no statistical estimators or new biological analysis. Signature-level and candidate-level data remain distinct.
Display_rounding: Word effects/coefficients generally 3 decimals; P/FDR 3 significant figures (scientific notation for small values); frozen cutoff full precision; DATA CSV original text precision.
Claim_boundary: ρ, Spearman correlation. The dataset contains 27,224 in-tissue spots across 17 sections nested within 4 canonical patients. Primary Core50–G2M/mitotic/spindle associations were positive in 51/51 raw and 51/51 technical-adjusted section-program comparisons. The secondary MS3/MS6 axis was raw-positive in 14/17 sections; adjusted signs were 8/17 positive and 9/17 negative. Adjustment covariates: detected genes, total counts and mitochondrial-count percentage. Spots and sections are not independent patient replicates; spatial exclusivity and causality are not demonstrated.
